Skipped via Elk's own mock-user mode: MOCK_USER (process.mock, the same mechanism as `pnpm dev:mocked`/.env.mock) is baked in at build time by .ui-capture/build.sh with server localhost:4410 and the stub's access token, so the browser opens already signed in as @maren (Maren Lindqvist). app.notes: Elk (Nuxt 4) production build served by its own Nitro server (`node .output/server/index.mjs`) on PORT, run in single-instance mode (NUXT_PUBLIC_SINGLE_INSTANCE=true, default server localhost:4410) so routes look like /home, /notifications, /@ingrid_b@scholar.social. Only code change: app/composables/masto/masto.ts and app/composables/users.ts use http:// instead of https:// when the server is localhost/127.0.0.1 (Elk hardcodes https). Tooling: mise.toml pins node 24.22.3 + pnpm 11.6.0 (attestation checks disabled because sigstore is unreachable); install used `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --pnpmfile .ui-capture/pnpmfile.cjs` because the sandbox forbids writing .vscode/.idea dirs that some tarballs ship (only change to pnpm-lock.yaml is the pnpmfileChecksum line). Rebuild with .ui-capture/build.sh. Data: logged-in user Maren Lindqvist (@maren), an urban ecologist in Gothenburg on 'Harbor Social'; 25 accounts (local and remote on scholar.social, fosstodon.org, hachyderm.io, mastodon.green, ...), ~190 statuses over the past ~8 months (dense in the last 3 weeks) with boosts, reply threads, polls (open and closed), content warnings, photo attachments, link cards, Swedish-language posts and DMs; ~200 notifications (favourites, boosts, mentions, follows, poll results, new-post alerts) with some unread; 6 direct-message conversations; 4 lists; 6 followed hashtags; trending tags/posts/links; bookmarks, favourites, 2 scheduled posts, 2 filters, follow requests, domain blocks. Dates are relative to server start so the account always looks active. Main areas: Home timeline (/home), Notifications (/notifications, /notifications/mention), Explore (/explore: posts, hashtags, news, people), Local/Federated (/public/local, /public), Messages (/conversations), Favourites, Bookmarks, Lists (/lists), Hashtags (/hashtags), profile (/@maren), thread view, compose, Settings.
